_comment: Add this object to SimCenterBackendApplications/modules/Workflow/WorkflowApplications.json under SystemPerformanceApplications.Applications (alongside REWETRecovery and ResidualDemand). The two-pipeline split is driven by the ApplicationData's "Mode" (reference|apply|both) and optional "Model" keys, read from configFile like Source/Sink; "model" is also exposed below as a path input so a saved reference model can be staged for an apply-only run.
Name: RSR2SP

ApplicationSpecificInputs.description: path to the network nodes geojson file
path to the network edges geojson file
path to the RSR SystemPerformance configuration JSON (the ApplicationData block: Source, Sink, FailureThresholdDS, DamageInput, and the optional Mode/Model pipeline controls)
optional path to a pre-extracted reference-model JSON (rsr_reference_model.json); written by a Mode='reference' run and read by a Mode='apply' run
